company.name: YouShift
company.shortDescription: YouShift provides healthier, happier healthcare teams through intelligent scheduling.
company.description: YouShift is an automated scheduling platform that simplifies shift management for healthcare professionals, leading to increased efficiency and improved work-life balance. By automating the complex process of shift assignments, YouShift considers staff preferences, availability, and compliance with work-hour regulations. This helps hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare organizations reduce administrative tasks and ensure optimal staffing levels, ultimately enhancing patient care.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-native scheduling engine that auto-generates compliant, fair hospital staff schedules across sites and teams.
productsAndServices.name: YouShift Scheduling Engine

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app that lets clinicians view schedules, manage availability, request time off, and trade shifts.
productsAndServices.name: YouShift Mobile Application

productsAndServices.description: An analytics dashboard that gives administrators real-time insight into staffing coverage, workload balance, and overtime trends.
